meta.title: BWILD, the plan
meta.desc: The plan behind the new BWILD site, the Luminous Vest reservation, the countdown and the Adventure Vest in one place. Prepared by Astra, October 2026.

cover.by: Prepared by Astra for Lupo Benatti, October 2026
cover.h: One site for the launch and the vest you sell today.
cover.lede: Today the Luminous Vest lives in three places. Here's the site that puts the €1 reservation, the countdown and the Adventure Vest in one, what runs underneath, what it costs and how it's ready before your Kickstarter.

found.t: The bar at the top of your site opens the €1 reservation on a second site, in a new tab. The KICKSTARTER tab leads to a page with no €1 offer on it.
Neither your Luminous Vest page nor the presale page gives a launch date yet.

found.src: Worked out from the sun's position for every day of the next year

today.lede: A runner who hears about the Luminous Vest can land in three places, and only one of them takes the €1 that locks 30% off. Your bar points to it in a new tab. Your KICKSTARTER tab points to Kickstarter's coming soon page.

dark.h: Most of a runner's winter starts in the dark.
dark.lede: That's the reason the Luminous Vest exists, so the site counts it for each runner. Pick a city and a run time. The count is worked out from the sun's position for every day of the next year, the same way the site does it.
dark.use: The same number is a line for your ads and posts, worked out for the city you're targeting.
dark.src: Sunrise and sunset from NOAA's solar position equations, worked out in your browser and checked against the astral library. A run counts as dark when it starts before sunrise or after sunset.

worth.h: Why the €1 belongs on your own site.
worth.label: more likely to convert than an email alone
worth.lede: LaunchBoom built the funnel your presale page runs on. In their words, people who put down $1 after giving their email were “30 times more likely to convert on average, as opposed to people who just gave us their email.” So the €1 is the most useful thing a runner can do before launch, and today it's a bar and a new tab away from your site.
worth.src: launchboom.com/crowdfunding-tips/how-to-build-a-prelaunch-email-list, read 26 Oct 2026. LaunchBoom's claim about its own funnel, not a figure we checked.

built.h: The new site, built around one run.
built.lede: One run carries down the page. The runner picks sunrise or night, sets the time and the city, sees what their year looks like, and the reservation arrives with their run already on it. Reserve for €1 is on the first screen, in a bar through the page, and again at the end of the headlights.

shots.p: Your own Instagram question opens the site. The answer sets a run time over the real sky in their city at that minute, with the price and Reserve for €1 right under it.

Scroll and a car comes up the road behind a runner. Your three slashes and the panel flare at 140 metres, the BFU's distance for reflective material in dipped headlights, and the TCS's 112 metres to stop at 80 km/h on a wet road is marked.
The runner's own time against a year of sunrise and sunset in their city. Every lit mark is a run that starts in the dark, worked out, never typed.
Urban to trail, without the safety gear look, in your words and with your loops from the presale page.
Email and €1, and a race bib prints with their number, run time and city, with 30% off stamped on it. In the prototype nothing is charged or sent.
The Adventure Vest at €98 with the specs, Davide's review and a cart, for the runner who wants a vest now.

under.lede: We'd keep what already works for you and put it in one place.
items: One site
bwildoutdoors.com, built from this prototype, in English and Italian like today.
The €1 reservation
LaunchKit keeps running it, with your payments, emails and ads, and it moves onto your own domain, which LaunchKit offers. A runner never changes site.
The Adventure Vest
Sold through Stripe Checkout, with your shipping and the 30 day returns as now.
The countdown
Reads one launch date you set. On the day, Reserve for €1 becomes Back it on Kickstarter.
The dark run counter
Works out sunrise and sunset in the visitor's browser. Nothing is stored and there's nothing to update.
One offer at a time
A first visit today meets 10% off in a popup and 30% for €1 in the bar. Until launch, the new site leads with the €1.
under.src: launchboom.com/launchkit, “so you can build your funnel on your own domain”, and your own pages, read 26 Oct 2026.
